title: What REALLY Happens When You Get a Tattoo

scenes.name: The Syringe Myth
scenes.narration: You might think a tattoo needle injects ink into your skin like a syringe. But that's not how it works at all.

scenes.name: Rapid Micro-Punctures
scenes.narration: Instead, the needle punctures your skin up to three thousand times a minute, tearing open the dermis and leaving pools of ink.

scenes.name: Immune System Invasion
scenes.narration: Your immune system immediately treats this as a massive attack, sending an army of white blood cells called macrophages to destroy the invader.

scenes.name: Phagocytosis Attempt
scenes.narration: These cells literally swallow the ink particles to dissolve them. But the pigment particles are far too large for their enzymes to digest.

scenes.name: The Cellular Tomb
scenes.narration: Unable to break the ink down, the macrophages become trapped, bloated with pigment, and eventually die locked inside your skin tissue.

scenes.name: The Eternal Biological Cycle
scenes.narration: When they die, new macrophages immediately swarm in to re-swallow the escaping ink, keeping the tattoo trapped in an endless biological loop.

scenes.name: Laser Shatter Resolution
scenes.narration: The only way to remove it is laser treatment, which shatters the ink into microscopic dust that your cells can finally flush away.
